title: 15th Blue Bridge Cup EDA provincial P1 charging-control area M1 v2

source.adaptation: LCEDA project workflow is replaced by editable KiCad native files; M1 uses the official charging-control-area topology and a custom KiCad resource library.

custom_symbol_electrical_model.reason: The official figures provide pin numbers and names but no electrical-type declarations; no type was inferred.
custom_symbol_electrical_model.erc_boundary: ERC cannot establish BCON power-input, open-drain, or other device semantics; topology and named-pin scoring remain independent evaluator checks.

public_evidence_requirements: receipt-bound native ERC and DRC results
sch/PCB parity and zero unconnected items
recorded limitations and unresolved engineering review items

automated.check: Every public prompt and custom-resource path exists and matches its contract SHA-256.
All nine references have the exact declared value, symbol, and footprint mapping.
automated.evidence: scorer schematic-netlist component metadata comparison; PCB parity is a separate managed-validation check

automated.check: Every declared network has the complete expected endpoint set, with no missing or extra endpoints, using the private holdout answer.
automated.evidence: independent scorer netlist comparison; endpoint answer is not in this package

automated.check: Automated validation checks the exposed layer, track/clearance, via, placement/silkscreen, expected GND-zone layer presence with filled positive area, and zero-unconnected fields; it does not establish actual GND-zone connectivity/effective coverage, and unsupported pad-to-slot or manufacturing fields remain unknown.
automated.evidence: revision-bound native inspection and supported rule receipts

automated.check: Managed validation confirms the editable schematic/PCB/project artifacts remain synchronized and bound to the final revision.
automated.evidence: managed validation receipt and artifact manifest

automated.check: ERC and DRC receipts are complete, bound to the final design revision/content hash, and their reported errors/warnings are recorded.
The engineering-candidate gate passes only when candidate_ready is true and all required editable artifacts and validations are complete; false or unknown fails.

manual_or_unknown.check: Human review of the AI-reconstructed BCON symbol/footprint against official figures.
Power-input, drive, open-drain, and other BCON electrical semantics are not inferred from pin names.
No BCON supply/current-limit or LED Vf/current_limit value is invented without a sourced specification.
Human confirmation that the stock JST footprint adaptation, pitch, body, and mechanical fit are appropriate for declared CN1 ZX-XH2.54-2PZZ.
Human or separately supported native review confirms GND-zone connectivity/effective coverage and pad-to-slot clearance; positive-area zone presence alone is insufficient.
Human review confirms silkscreen dimensions, legibility, and clearance; automated presence is not a dimensional or readability sign-off.
Human manufacturability, procurement, and hardware-operation review.

scoring_boundary.symmetric_pin_policy: For the listed non-polarized two-terminal components, endpoint-set comparison must accept a pin-1/pin-2 swap when the component identity, value, footprint, and all net memberships remain correct.
required_evaluator_checks: exact endpoint-set comparison for every declared net
native rule, ERC/DRC, and connectivity evidence bound to the final design revision
human review of polarity, package equivalence, and manufacturability

limitations: This v2 input contract is not a benchmark result and has not been executed.
C13 and C14 are deliberately non-polarized Device:C inputs; no capacitor polarity or orientation claim is made.
Custom BCON resources are an AI reconstruction from official figures and require independent human review.
The official figure gives package geometry but not a manufacturer qualification or a verified BCON datasheet.
The task has no sourced BCON supply/current-limit or LED Vf/current_limit parameters; those values must not be invented.
CN1 uses a stock 2.50 mm JST XH footprint as a declared stock-footprint adaptation for ZX-XH2.54-2PZZ; pitch, body outline, and mechanical fit require human confirmation.
ERC cannot establish BCON power-input, drive, open-drain, or other electrical semantics when the supplied symbol declares all pins passive.
